scope: flash exact reviewed playback image to boot
Reuse byte-identical installed HAL plugin; validate preserved originals and durable journal
read USB logs and audio counters
bounded silent DMA and quiet one-second tone
play iOS app audio, verify volume/mute and clean repeated start/stop
steps: After exact image authorization and fastboot, verify single oplus6893 device and 32MiB boot. Flash boot once and start 600-second read-only console capture before reboot.
Require existing HAL reuse mode1 phase2 error0. If prelaunch transaction rejects/halts, capture evidence and use prepared rollback image; never start stock Android over iOS userdata.

Confirm lockscreen and controls. Read tools/nord2-audio-live.py status. Require board_status=1 initialized=1 error=0 uncertain=0 stop_error=0. Save JSON and console snapshot. Require measured supported TFA9874 revisions on both amps; preserve saved ownership diagnostics and inherited clock snapshot.
Use stop to suspend unsolicited HAL audio. Run silent once; wait beyond its 1-second deadline, then query status. Stop if any fault. A silent DMA result is not proof of speaker output.
Run fixed quiet tone once only after clean silent result. Save status after expiry and ask whether the tone was audible from either/both speakers. Do not blindly repeat on unknown command outcome.

Enable HAL playback; play one sound or media clip from iOS at moderate slider level. Compare opens/writes/peak/pcm/underruns and ask audibility. Try volume and pause/resume. Initial hardware ceiling remains256/32768.
Confirm Wi-Fi browsing, touch/buttons, absence of panic/reboot and no audio error after playback. Save immutable log plus SHA and exact image/source/run identity.
recovery: Verified new audio rollback image executes mode2 before launchd and preserves current Wi-Fi source; it can reverse committed HAL layout without carrying plugin package.
If rollback cannot validate the journal/layout, preserve evidence and use tested RAM ADB rescue for repair; never erase the journal blindly.
Old55c65bc7 alone does not undo persistent HAL changes and is usable as baseline only after confirmed rollback.
limits: Speaker playback only. No implemented microphone or telephony audio.
HAL installation and nonzero iOS PCM delivery were verified on prior boots; actual MMIO speaker playback is not hardware-proven yet.
Board container comes from pinned stock Nord2 A16 community vendor source; exact current handset firmware identity was not dumped.
No speaker-protection DSP implementation; initial gain deliberately capped.
